name: Dairy Farm ERP - Offline-Ready Farm Management System
description: Professional, offline-ready Dairy Farm ERP for Windows Laptop & Desktop (Electron / Web). Features female & male herd management, individual cow & shift milk tracking with weighted Fat/SNF, group-based feed (Maund/KG), veterinary health automation, breeding cycles, customer sales & invoices, worker ledger, expenses, and automated reminders.
